items.text: Having up to 56 g of cannabis or 15 g of resin in a public place gets a XCD 50 fixed penalty notice, not a criminal charge (s 7(a)).
Smoking cannabis in any public place, other than a registered Rastafarian place of worship or an authorised place, gets a XCD 1,000 fixed penalty notice (s 7(b)).
More than 56 g of cannabis or 15 g of resin is presumed to be for trafficking (s 6(4)). Medicinal cannabis is licensed under the Cannabis Act 2020.
